title: More Players
author: NeZorSpy
description:
Raises CRACK's crew limit from 4 to 8 players (MaxPlayers, 1-8).
• Network: Mirror maxConnections and the Steam lobby size follow the MaxPlayers setting.
• Player slots: GameManager.GetAvailablePlayerIndex no longer stops at 4.
• Double rooms: players 5-8 get a bunk bed above players 1-4 (the static-batched bed is rebuilt from mesh data extracted from the game), and share the badge door and wardrobe of their room. The door plate shows both names.
• UI: a unique colour per player, an auto-scrolling end-of-shift list, and ranking monitors that page through players 4 at a time.
• Work order: quotas keep scaling past 4 players (QuotaMultiplier, default x1.25 at 8), and shop unlocks always match the current step.
Every player in the lobby needs the mod (CRACK keeps modded and vanilla lobbies apart). Setting: BepInEx/config/nezorspy.crack.moreplayers.cfg
